name: Baguio City Open 2017

venue.name: [Bulwagang Juan Luna](http://www.upb.edu.ph)
venue.details: From the entrance, head straight to the parking lot, proceed to the lobby and then turn left.

information: This is the 3rd competition organized by UP Cubers of the University of the Philippines - Baguio City Campus. Base registration fee is 250php, good for 3 events. Additional events registered shall entail 50php additional registration fee each.
